note: The built-in default plan of tools/caepipe_correlation/sitting_pack.py. Parts run in the order listed: what cannot be redone later comes first, so a sitting cut short leaves the least behind. A case is placed in the first part that selects it. estimate is filled by whoever plans the sitting and is printed as an estimate, not a condition.

parts.title: Dry run
parts.buys: Two or three small cases taken through the whole route and back through ingest and the parser on this host before anything else is run, so that a capture failure is found on the first day. The format samples make the program print result sections that no public page describes.

format_samples.title: Limit stop with gaps
format_samples.purpose: a nonlinear support's status in the printed results

format_samples.title: Variable spring hanger
format_samples.purpose: the hanger report in the printed results

format_samples.title: Straight span with modal analysis
format_samples.purpose: frequencies and mode shapes in the printed results

variant.label: modal-3
variant.instruction: Before analysing, switch on the modal (frequency) analysis and ask for 3 modes. Change nothing else.

parts.title: Pressurised default series
parts.buys: The cases that carry the exact pressure contract. Without them the pressure route is compared on no case.

parts.title: Format observations
parts.buys: Records of how the program writes and reads files, kept to settle interoperation facts no public page states. They are stored as returned and not interpreted by ingest.

parts.title: Sealed captures
parts.buys: The program's output for cases whose SWBPIPE side is not ready yet, captured while a run is still possible. They stay sealed until a tolerance class with a value exists for them and SWBPIPE's own result is bound.
parts.sealed_reason: SWBPIPE's side of these cases is not ready; no agent opens the capture before a tolerance class with a value is named for it and SWBPIPE's result for the case is bound.
parts.empty_reason: No family is named yet whose SWBPIPE side is not ready; the plan for the sitting names them.

parts.title: Tranche 1 remainder
parts.buys: Tranche 1 cases a plan names for a further run, by family, with the members of one series next to each other and smaller models first.
parts.empty_reason: Tranche 1's cases already have complete stored results; this part selects nothing unless a plan names cases for it.
